description: Pull inbound Gmail replies into matching leads' timelines (list_lead_messages). Only matches to EXISTING leads (via a prior email link, else an exact leads.email match) — never creates new leads from unmatched senders. No-op if Gmail isn't connected (Integrations page). No server-side push (no cron) — call this periodically to pick up new mail. Returns { fetched, matched, skipped_unmatched, skipped_blacklisted }.
name: sync_gmail
